symptom: An engine launched from a Local agent shell resolved an inherited credential shim as real Git, leaving detached shells that re-executed themselves indefinitely.
rule: Resolve through inherited wrappers and test both the resolver and script re-entry. The bug-fix playbook requires a bounded reproduction; Local and cloud normal invocations remain covered by the adjacent shim suite.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/git/__tests__/credential-shim-recursion.test.ts -t 'skips shims reached'
